value.rationale: The arbitrary multi-spoke exact positive cone and global non-reentrant horizon are a natural complete classification for preserving nonnegative heat states under a standard fourth-order integrator. One scalar inequality or a unique 1D root replaces matrixwise sign searches; the maximal spoke pinpoints first loss. The pseudoinverse characterization ties numerical positivity to a structural Green-function property. This strictly generalizes but does not rebrand the prior one-outlier special case.
